name: Vowbough
silhouette: Tall four-legged cervid with a low living face and two outward growing flat branch fans; broad negative space between antlers, neck and high forelegs. No crown icon or weapon silhouette.
motion: Foreleg reaches, hindleg pushes, branch fans lag and recover. Short turns lower the head before the torso follows.

name: Kilnwhorl
silhouette: Low living nautilus with a huge off-center spiral shell, a soft forward face and broad divided mantle feet; one open shell notch glows, never a wheeled furnace.
motion: Mantle ripples pull the shell forward; shell rocks opposite each two-foot step. Pauses let the eye stalk settle independently.

name: Cairnward
silhouette: Long low anteater-like body with an expressive narrow snout, four stout claws and three tall separated stone ridges along a continuous back; its sweeping tail makes an open arch behind it.
motion: Heavy diagonal steps, nose tests the ground before each push, ridges roll in sequence; turns use a broad tail counterbalance.

name: Bellmantle
silhouette: Upright stag beetle with a small visible face, one narrow curved mandible and one broad crescent mandible, separated long forelegs and two hanging bell-shaped wing cases.
motion: Rear legs stride, forelegs tap the ground independently, wing cases swing against the body and stop at different moments.

name: Shadeweaver
silhouette: Broad eight-legged silk spider with a clearly visible gentle two-eyed face, four high arching rear legs and a suspended leaf canopy attached to its living back. Gaps beneath all arches remain readable.
motion: Opposite leg pairs lift in a slow woven rhythm; canopy tilts without obscuring the face, shadow remains inside the planted feet.

name: Tideplume
silhouette: Long-necked shorebird with three connected fan-like tail sails, narrow high legs, a flat beak and a low forward crest; one continuous living torso prevents a floating-boat reading.
motion: Two measured high steps then a short skim; tail fans change overlap and the grounded shadow catches up before the next step.

name: Hearthmoth
silhouette: Low broad moth with two huge triangular veined wings, a clear small face between short feathery antennae and two warm abdominal lights. Wing openings make an asymmetric roof shape.
motion: Four visible foot steps beneath shallow wing lifts; the abdomen settles after each turn instead of bobbing as one flat sprite.
